plugins.name: relai
plugins.description: Your project remembers everything — documentation-first process framework for Claude Code

plugins.name: relai-panel
plugins.description: Early access — needs Claude Code with mods (measured on 2.1.295). RelAI panel: a calm bar above the prompt with the session's work (a plan stage or a thread card and its packets), its status, and a second row only while a decision card waits or the work is not chosen (then a Wybierz pracę… button opens the pane on the choice); /relai-panel opens a pane with Teraz (the work, its next item, Zmień to pick it), forms for the 14 RelAI commands, a map that starts with Ta sesja (the focus with its packets and cost) over folded sections of plans, crew runs and the archive, the project documents and the session's measured costs in folded sections. Every change goes through a confirmation card. One network request only: the Anthropic pricing page, read after "Tak" on a card.

plugins.name: relai-progress
plugins.description: Early access — needs Claude Code with mods (measured on 2.1.293). RelAI progress above the prompt: segments of the stage in progress or a /relai-crew run with the next item under them, a chip with the session's agents and their cost, and /relai-agents with the session's subagents priced from the project's price list. Reads files only: no model call, no network. Based on savvy-progress by johnnyvizz (MIT).

plugins.name: relai-cache-keeper
plugins.description: Early access — needs Claude Code with mods (measured on 2.1.295). Five batteries above the prompt — the prompt cache's time left, the 5-hour limit, the time to its reset, the weekly limit and the context — each showing what is left, with the full words on hover and the session's cost once, on the right; asks before a cold send of a big context and says when a fresh session pays off (/cache shows the reckoning). Calls the model only on the person's request (keep-warm pings, hand-off to a fresh chat).
